title: How is seva typically assigned, and how many hours of daily service are expected from guests?

segments.text: Seva (selfless service) is a heartfelt expression of devotion, and we welcome everyone to participate according to their own capacity: ​Voluntary & Heartfelt: Seva is entirely voluntary—there is no obligation or set expectation. Every disciple and guest is free to serve according to their own faith, time, and devotion toward Gurudev. ​Cultivating Humility: While not mandatory, participating in seva is warmly encouraged. As disciples of Gurudev, offering service in any small way is a meaningful duty that helps cultivate deep humility, inner purity, and connection with the community. ​No Fixed Hours or Standards: There are no set limitations or rigid hours required. Whether you can offer a few minutes or a couple of hours, every act of service is appreciated. To each their own—you are free to contribute in whatever way feels right for you.
